00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000039.title: Chapter 03
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000039.synopsis: Chapter heading and epigraph, kept in the chapter folder’s own document. It opens when you click the folder.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000039.notes: Every folder has one of these; this one has something in it. Keep the epigraph; cut the rest if it reads as throat-clearing.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000005.title: The lighthouse keeper
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000005.synopsis: An old family friend offers Mara a room and an unsettling warning: some things on the island are better left unremembered.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000005.notes: Elin is warm, practical, and keeping one enormous secret.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000012.title: The photograph
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000012.synopsis: Elin explains the photograph, or tries to. Mara learns she was on the island the day her father vanished, and that she has forgotten it on purpose.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000012.notes: Elin gives up one truth and keeps two. Mara should feel the floor move.
